title: What should world-model systems log?
summary: Log perception, inferred state and action with timestamps.
body: For consequential systems, the paper recommends time-stamped records of what the system perceived, the state it inferred and the action it took. This supports incident reconstruction, accountability and assignment of duties across developers, deployers, operators and integrators.

claims: Log perception, inferred state and action with timestamps.
